thread:
Maya Patel: Tagging window in ~30m — quick checklist: version bump, changelog merge, annotated signed tag, upload artifacts, attach checksums, then publish draft. Who's on release duty? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Oliver Chen: I can take the annotated tag + GH draft. What exact version are we cutting?

Sophia Alvarez: Changelog PR merged, bumped package.json to 1.7.0 in main. I can validate checksums once artifacts land.

Kevin Brooks: CI looks green except one rpm-arm64 flake, I'll retry that job now.

ci-bot: build/1795549912 ✅, build/1795549999 ❌ (rpm-arm64). Requeued build 1795550100.

Diego Morales: Heads up — staging GPG key differs from prod. Use the release key when signing artifacts (I can provide key ID). Steps below.

Diego Morales: ```
# create annotated signed tag
git tag -a v1.7.0 -m "release v1.7.0" -s
git push origin v1.7.0

# create GH draft release and upload assets
gh release create v1.7.0 --draft --title "v1.7.0" --notes-file CHANGELOG.md
gh release upload v1.7.0 dist/*.tar.gz dist/*.rpm --clobber

# checksums & signatures
sha256sum dist/* > dist/SHA256SUMS
gpg --detach-sign --armor dist/SHA256SUMS
```

Maya Patel: Perfect. Oliver — please ensure annotated + signed tag (no lightweight tags), and add SHA256SUMS + SHA256SUMS.asc as release assets. Also paste the release notes link in the thread when ready.

Oliver Chen: Will wait for the rpm job to finish before uploading. One question: do we need to manually pin docker image tags in the release notes or does CI handle that?

Sophia Alvarez: CI will push docker images tagged v1.7.0 once artifacts are uploaded and the release draft exists (we have a webhook). No manual docker step required.

ci-bot: build/1795550100 ✅ (rpm-arm64). Artifacts published to s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/1.7.0/

Sophia Alvarez: Downloaded artifacts and ran checksums locally — all sha256 sums match :white_check_mark:.

Oliver Chen: Draft release created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/tag/v1.7.0 (draft). Uploaded dist/*.tar.gz, dist/*.rpm, SHA256SUMS, SHA256SUMS.asc. Leaving as draft for final sign-off.

Maya Patel: Final checklist before publish: @Kevin quick changelog sanity-check, @Diego confirm signature ID appears in release notes, and then I'll publish.

Kevin Brooks: Quick pass done — wording tweak on the security note (pushed a one-line edit to CHANGELOG.md). LGTM after that.

Diego Morales: Signature ID for the release key: 0xDEADBEEF. I'll add a line to the notes with that fingerprint.

Maya Patel: Publishing in 5. :rocket:

release-bot: Published release v1.7.0 — https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/tag/v1.7.0

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the post-release checklist items (announce, update internal release doc, bump docs). :tada:
